YellowSphere.html Cross-Platform Test Instructions
=====================================================

The yellowsphere-app.js Playwright fixture works on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Run all commands from the repository root (the directory containing package.json).

Prerequisites
-------------

- Node.js and npm
- A supported Playwright browser

Install project dependencies:

    npm install

Install Playwright Chromium:

    npx playwright install chromium

Linux may also require browser system dependencies:

    npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

Run Tests
---------

Run the production HTML smoke and encryption tests:

    npm run test:html

Run only the critical browser smoke test:

    npm run test:smoke

Run only the encryption tests:

    npm run test:crypto

Optional System Browser Override
--------------------------------

PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH can select an existing Chromium-family browser
instead of Playwright's downloaded Chromium.

Windows PowerShell example using Microsoft Edge:

    $env:PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'
    npm run test:html

macOS example using Google Chrome:

    PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" npm run test:html

Linux example using Chromium:

    PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium npm run test:html

Notes
-----

- tests/fixtures/yellowsphere-app.js starts a temporary local HTTP server and loads
  YellowSphere.html into Playwright.
- tests/yellowsphere-html.smoke.spec.js covers critical application flows.
- tests/yellowsphere-encryption.spec.js covers ARC encryption, encrypted keyfiles,
  tamper rejection, credential handling, and legacy compatibility.
- tests/tauri/run-release-harness.py dispatches Tauri preflight checks to the
  current host platform.
- tests/tauri/windows-release-harness.ps1 builds or validates Windows MSI/NSIS
  artifacts.
- tests/tauri/macos-release-harness.sh builds or validates Intel, Apple Silicon,
  and universal macOS app/DMG artifacts.
- tests/tauri/linux-release-harness.sh builds or validates Linux amd64 ELF,
  Debian, and RPM artifacts. On macOS it uses the documented Ubuntu 22.04
  amd64 Docker builder.
